title: Module Registry Manifest Contract
summary: Register module manifests, versions, dependencies and permissions without absorbing capability catalog ownership.

criteria: The manifest shape is human-approved before implementation: module id, version, dependency list, permission request set and signature are all mandatory fields.
Manifest validation is closed: an unknown field is rejected at registration time rather than stored for later interpretation.
dependency resolution is specified as deterministic and version-aware, and an unsatisfiable dependency blocks registration instead of degrading to a partial install.
Every permission request passes a least-privilege review, and a module never receives a permission it did not declare in its manifest.
The module lifecycle is fixed as registered, resolved, active, passive and retired, with every transition recorded in an append-only audit.

risks.desc: Registering a module without verifying its signature would let a forged manifest enter the registry and inherit the permissions it declares for itself.
risks.mitigation: Require signature verification before the registered state and reject a tamper-detected manifest, with forged-manifest negatives before human-approved implementation.

risks.desc: Accepting a permission request without least-privilege review would let a module obtain broad authority through its own manifest declaration.
risks.mitigation: Bind every permission request to a least-privilege review and prove an undeclared permission is never exercisable at any lifecycle state.

risks.desc: A non-deterministic or partially applied dependency resolution would leave a module half-registered and its dependents silently broken.
risks.mitigation: Fix deterministic version-aware resolution where an unsatisfiable dependency blocks registration, and prove no partial state is reachable.

risks.desc: A module registry could be misread as authority over the capability catalog, plugin registration or the authorization decision path.
risks.mitigation: Keep no capability catalog ownership, no plugin registration, no identity/authentication and no authorization decision explicit, and preserve NO-GO without new human authority.

featureDefs.title: Özellik Tanımları
items: A manifest is the closed record that declares module id, version, dependency list, permission request set and signature; anything outside that set is an unknown field and is rejected.
dependency resolution is deterministic and version-aware, so the same manifest set always resolves identically and an unsatisfiable edge blocks registration.
Each permission request is a declaration only; it becomes usable after a least-privilege review and never before.
The lifecycle is the closed sequence registered, resolved, active, passive and retired, and each transition is written to an append-only audit.
capability declaration inside a manifest is discovery metadata ve bu sözleşmenin kapsam sınırı gereği capability catalog ownership veya plugin registration üstlenilmez.

featureDefs.prompt: Module Registry Manifest Contract featureDefs kapsamı. Kapsa: closed manifest field set with module id, version, dependency list, permission request and signature; unknown field rejection; deterministic dependency resolution; least-privilege permission review; registered/resolved/active/passive/retired lifecycle with append-only audit. Exclude capability catalog ownership, plugin registration, identity/authentication and authorization decision. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

security.title: Güvenlik Önlemleri
items: A signature is verified before a module reaches the registered state, so an unsigned or tampered manifest never enters the registry.
Every permission request passes a least-privilege review and an undeclared permission is unusable at every lifecycle state, so a module cannot widen its own authority.
identity/authentication and the authorization decision itself stay outside this contract; the registry records what a module asked for and never decides an access request.
Registry rows are tenant scoped and fail-closed, and an append-only audit preserves every registration and lifecycle transition with a before/after hash.

codeOptimization.title: Kod Optimizasyonu
items: The planned handoff keeps one manifest parser and one resolution routine rather than per-module special cases, with a short-code bütçe sınırı and katman separation.
Resolution is a pure function of the manifest version set with bounded cyclomatic complexity, so the outcome is reproducible and testable without a live registry.
Conformance and pinning rules are referenced through the predecessor contract instead of restated here.
codeOptimization.notes: module-registry-manifest-contract/codeOptimization: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
codeOptimization.prompt: Module Registry Manifest Contract codeOptimization kapsamı. Kapsa: single manifest parser and resolver, pure reproducible resolution, referenced conformance rules. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

securityOptimization.title: Güvenlik Optimizasyonu
items: Boundary validation allowlists every manifest key and permission identifier; an unknown field or unrecognised permission name is refused rather than coerced.
Least-privilege separates manifest submission from registry approval: a submitting module cannot approve its own permission request or advance its own lifecycle.
Immutable audit records who registered, resolved, activated, deactivated or retired a module together with the manifest hash at that moment.
securityOptimization.notes: module-registry-manifest-contract/securityOptimization: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
securityOptimization.prompt: Module Registry Manifest Contract securityOptimization kapsamı. Kapsa: manifest key and permission allowlist, submission/approval separation, immutable lifecycle audit. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

performance.title: Performans Optimizasyonu
items: Planned dependency resolution must stay bounded for a realistic module graph and must not degrade superlinearly as the registry grows, with a p95 resolution budget declared per registry size; no measurement is claimed here.
Registry lookups must avoid N+1 queries when expanding a module's dependency list and permission request set.
Performance evidence must cover signature verification cost and resolution time at registry scale before any readiness claim.
performance.notes: module-registry-manifest-contract/performance: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
performance.prompt: Module Registry Manifest Contract performance kapsamı. Kapsa: bounded dependency resolution, N+1 avoidance on registry expansion, signature verification cost. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

mobileApps.title: Mobil Uygulama Uyumu
items: Mobile, web and service channels read the same manifest and cannot register a channel-local module version or relax a permission request.
An offline client keeps the last resolved manifest version and refuses to assume a newer lifecycle state it has not observed.
No mobile management surface is introduced; presenting the registry stays a separate consumer responsibility.
mobileApps.notes: module-registry-manifest-contract/mobileApps: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
mobileApps.prompt: Module Registry Manifest Contract mobileApps kapsamı. Kapsa: shared manifest across channels, conservative offline lifecycle assumption, no management surface here. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

wcag.title: WCAG 2.2 AAA
items: Any future registry console must expose module lifecycle state and permission request outcome as accessible text rather than by icon or color alone.

A registration rejection such as an unknown field or failed signature must be announced through an aria live region, stay keyboard reachable with a visible focus ring and meet the AAA contrast threshold.
No rendered surface is produced by this contract, so every accessibility result stays planned and unclaimed at this node.
wcag.notes: module-registry-manifest-contract/wcag: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
wcag.prompt: Module Registry Manifest Contract wcag kapsamı. Kapsa: accessible lifecycle and permission outcome text, announced registration rejections, no surface produced here. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

deployment.title: Dağıtım (Swarm/K8s/Shared)
items: This shard performs no release or deploy; any future Docker/Kubernetes deployment of the registry store and signature verification path remains human-developer work.
A future deployment must publish a new manifest version append-only so an already-resolved dependent keeps reading the version it resolved against.
Any reversal is confined to this planning contract and its deterministic projections, keeping runtimeDataImpact none and the NO-GO verdict intact.
deployment.notes: module-registry-manifest-contract/deployment: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
deployment.prompt: Module Registry Manifest Contract deployment kapsamı. Kapsa: no release or deploy here, append-only manifest version publication, confined reversal. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

eca.title: ECA Kuralları
items: This contract is registration, not automation: a lifecycle transition may emit a planned event but no ruleset acts on module behaviour here.
No webhook, outbox or automatic activation is created by this node; the least-privilege permission review cannot be bypassed by a rule.
Automation may record a planned approval request but cannot register a module, grant a permission or claim successful runtime execution.
eca.notes: module-registry-manifest-contract/eca: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
eca.prompt: Module Registry Manifest Contract eca kapsamı. Kapsa: lifecycle events only, no ruleset module automation, permission review cannot be bypassed. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

aiAgents.title: AI Ajan Davranışı
items: AI may read the registry contract and suggest a changeset, but registering a module, granting a permission request, advancing a lifecycle state and bypassing tenant scope are forbidden actions ve yasak kalır.
An implementation or activation step proceeds only after explicit insan onayı; there is no automatic apply path, no admin override and no delegated-admin shortcut for an AI lane.
No prompt instruction or repository text may stretch this shard's fixed D01 scope, produce platform product code or upgrade a planned-test ref into recorded evidence.
aiAgents.notes: module-registry-manifest-contract/aiAgents: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
aiAgents.prompt: Module Registry Manifest Contract aiAgents kapsamı. Kapsa: read and suggest-changeset only, forbidden registration and permission grant, mandatory human approval. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

testing.title: Testler & QA
items: Planned positive cases register a well-formed manifest and walk it through registered, resolved, active, passive and retired.
Planned negatives cover an unknown field, a missing or invalid signature, an unsatisfiable dependency and a permission request refused by least-privilege review.
Planned negatives prove an undeclared permission is never exercisable and that a lifecycle transition cannot skip a state.
Planned tenant isolation negatives exercise cross-tenant manifest reads and registrations and prove the append-only audit is never rewritten.
Both the planned pytest command and the kernelIntegration plannedTestRefs remain unexecuted here; they name evidence a human developer still owes.
testing.notes: module-registry-manifest-contract/testing: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
testing.prompt: Module Registry Manifest Contract testing kapsamı. Kapsa: full lifecycle positive walk, unknown-field and signature negatives, unsatisfiable dependency, least-privilege refusal, undeclared permission, tenant isolation negatives. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

owasp.title: OWASP & Standartlar
items: OWASP A08 software and data integrity risk is modeled through mandatory signature verification and manifest schema validation, so an unsigned or tampered manifest never registers.
OWASP A01 broken access control is modeled through least-privilege permission review plus tenant-scoped registry rows and refusal of any undeclared permission.
OWASP A06 vulnerable and outdated components risk is modeled through version-aware dependency resolution and a retired lifecycle state that removes a module from resolution.
owasp.notes: module-registry-manifest-contract/owasp: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
owasp.prompt: Module Registry Manifest Contract owasp kapsamı. Kapsa: A08 signature integrity, A01 least-privilege and tenant scoping, A06 version-aware resolution and retirement. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

integration.title: Kernel/Core Entegrasyonu
items: Kernel integration is contributor -> app-kernel/k-sozlesme with contributionKind specification, targetProviderIds [k-mod-l] and runtimeProviderClaimAllowed=false.
All publicBoundary flags remain false, so a registry consumer touches no kernel internal, no kernel database and no cross-context write path.
This schedule is only a planning window; predecessor schema-pinning-conformance-contract ends 2027-02-14, so no executable-order or readiness claim is allowed.
dependsOn stays exactly schema-pinning-conformance-contract and does not inherit the parent-only be-kararlar, board, edu-u09, overview and k-bus edges.
Scope stays inside the registration layer: no capability catalog ownership, no plugin registration, no identity/authentication and no authorization decision.
integration.notes: module-registry-manifest-contract/integration: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
integration.prompt: Module Registry Manifest Contract integration kapsamı. Kapsa: contributor routing to k-mod-l under areaId k-sozlesme, closed public boundary, exact dependsOn, planning window marker and the fixed exclusion set. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

moduleUsage.title: Modül Kullanımı
items: A consuming app reads a module's manifest to learn its version and capability declaration and cannot infer a permission the manifest never declared.
A consumer must preserve tenant scope when reading the registry and cannot advance or reinterpret another module's lifecycle state.
Choosing which capabilities a tenant may buy or enable remains a capability catalog authority outside this registry.
moduleUsage.notes: module-registry-manifest-contract/moduleUsage: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
moduleUsage.prompt: Module Registry Manifest Contract moduleUsage kapsamı. Kapsa: consumer manifest reads, preserved tenant scope, capability catalog ownership excluded. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

dataLifecycle.title: Veri Yaşam Döngüsü & Uyum
items: Manifests hold module metadata rather than PII, but registration actor records identify people under KVKK/GDPR, so veri sınıflandırması, purpose, owner and retention approval are required before implementation; DSAR silme veya anonimleştirme yolu istenir.
A retired module version stays readable under append-only evolution so a past resolution decision can be reconstructed exactly.
Audit retention is purpose-limited and tenant-scoped, and no module payload or runtime data store is created by this node.
dataLifecycle.notes: module-registry-manifest-contract/dataLifecycle: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
dataLifecycle.prompt: Module Registry Manifest Contract dataLifecycle kapsamı. Kapsa: registration actor data classification, append-only retired version readability, tenant-scoped audit retention, no store created here. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

observability.title: Gözlemlenebilirlik & Operasyon
items: Planned SLI/SLO metrics include registration rejection counts by reason, signature verification failure rate, unsatisfiable dependency rate and lifecycle transition counts on tenant-safe labels.
Logs and traces carry module id, version and tenant scope with PII redaction; manifest payloads and permission bodies are never metric labels.
Alerts cover a signature verification failure spike, a permission granted without a recorded least-privilege review and an audit gap on a lifecycle transition; thresholds require human approval.
observability.notes: module-registry-manifest-contract/observability: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
observability.prompt: Module Registry Manifest Contract observability kapsamı. Kapsa: registration and signature SLIs, redacted module labels, permission-review and audit-gap alerts. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

reliability.title: Dayanıklılık & Süreklilik
items: The primary failure mode is an unresolvable dependency or an unverifiable signature; it degrades to a refused registration and never to a partially registered module.
The same manifest set must always resolve to the same dependency outcome; retry and idempotency controls cannot change a resolution or a permission decision.
Retiring a version never rewrites an earlier resolution record; append-only evolution preserves read compatibility and rollback safety.
reliability.notes: module-registry-manifest-contract/reliability: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
reliability.prompt: Module Registry Manifest Contract reliability kapsamı. Kapsa: fail-closed refusal on unresolvable dependency or bad signature, deterministic resolution, append-only retirement. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.
